node.title: KoalaBear m2 u2 universal source-facet census
node.closure: stabilizer-independent (10,10,4) star census and five exhaustive K-fiber degree profiles
node.statement: Every actual degree-two source component in the order-two or trivial-stabilizer inner-degree-two rows has exact star census (J-J,I-I,I-J)=(10,10,4). The ten J-J stars over the five common K fibers have total degree 20 on the six J labels and, up to permutation, exactly one of five profiles: (0,4,4,4,4,4), (1,3,4,4,4,4), (2,2,4,4,4,4), (2,3,3,4,4,4), or (3,3,3,3,4,4). No stabilizer symmetry is used; the coordinate orientation narrows this list separately. No packet or type is deleted.
